title: Soul Snack #6: Creating Authentic Power – Mastering Fear & Choosing Love
excerpt: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the journey of creating authentic power, which he describes as aligning your personality with your soul and consistently choosing love over fear.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the journey of creating authentic power, which he describes as aligning your personality with your soul and consistently choosing love over fear. 

Gary explains that authentic power is achieved through commitment to spiritual growth, emotional awareness, and the conscious decision to act from a loving part of our personality, even when fear is present.

Gary guides us through the practice of emotional awareness, encouraging us to notice physical sensations associated with fear or love in our energy processing centers. 

By developing this awareness, we can recognize when a frightened part of our personality is active and choose to respond from a place of love.

This practice gradually lessens the control fear has over us and helps us live a life of meaning and purpose, guided by love. 

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (00:47) What is authentic power? Understanding how aligning with your soul creates true strength and guides you to love. 
  • (01:29) The role of commitment in spiritual growth. Discover why making spiritual growth your highest priority is essential for creating authentic power.
  • (08:04) Techniques for identifying physical sensations linked to fearful or loving parts of your personality. 
  • (08:35) Embracing authentic power as a lifelong journey – creating authentic power is a gradual process but you will get there.
